26.2.1.1.0: Fabric support alongside NeoForge. Tamed pets, babies and named mobs can be protected; modded bosses are recognised; slimes, ghasts and phantoms keep their own AI. The exempt list now survives restarts. Fixes: reload and toggle no longer ignore the config, and damage no longer compounds on reload.
26.2.1.0.6: Port to Minecraft 26.2 (Chaos Cubed). The new Sulfur Cube keeps its vanilla behaviour by default, like slimes and magma cubes. Land mobs swim across water toward you; config commands now persist to disk.

26.1.1.0.6: Land mobs now swim across water toward you instead of bouncing in deep water. Config commands (/alaaggro toggle, set) now persist to disk instead of resetting on world reload.
26.1.1.0.5: Fix mobs jittering on water and lava surfaces; water creatures no longer leap out and now chase through water.
26.1.1.0.4: Stop console spam — per-mob aggro injection now logs at DEBUG instead of INFO.
26.1.1.0.2: Enable in-game Settings button via IConfigScreenFactory.
26.1.1.0.1: Local rebuild; verify master enabled toggle coverage.
26.1.1.0.0: Initial public release. Every mob attacks the player on sight.
